description: This file defines API route handlers for user management in a FastAPI application, including searching, getting, creating, updating, and deleting users via GraphQL client interactions.

methods.name: GrafanaClient _client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the GrafanaClient used for API requests.

methods.name: search_users(query: str | None = Query(None, description="Search query"), page: int = 1, per_page: int = 25, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search Grafana users based on a query string, page, and per_page parameters.

methods.name: get_user(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific user by ID.

methods.name: create_user(payload: UserCreate, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new Grafana user with provided user data.

methods.name: update_user(id: int, payload: UserUpdate, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing user by ID.

methods.name: delete_user(id: int, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a user by ID.

ctags.name: get_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_user(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token/
ctags.signature: (id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))

ctags.name: search_users
ctags.pattern: /^async def search_users(query: str | None = Query(None, description="Search query"), page: int = /
ctags.signature: (query: str | None = Query(None, description="Search query"), page: int = 1, per_page: int = 25, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))

ctags.name: update_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_user(id: int, payload: UserUpdate, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token)):$/
